breaking.change: A caption track draws nothing. The engine used to draw the showing key itself, white on a black plate over everything, at the track's anchor and type step. The keys showing are now the UI's $captions store, and the track's and keys' style and anchor entries are refused: a caption is text only.
breaking.fix: Push the built-in subtitles screen once (og.ui.push("subtitles", { lines: [] })): it shows $captions after the game's own lines, dressed by the style pack. Delete style and anchor from caption tracks; to place or size captions differently, iterate $captions in a document of your own.

added.summary: $captions, read by every document like $ui unless a mount binds its own captions: the lines the playing timelines are saying now, a collection of { id, text } keyed by id, in the order of the timelines and of their caption tracks. Each key is a row of its own, so a line that stays is not rebuilt when another joins or goes.
The built-in subtitles screen shows $captions after its own lines, with nothing to pass.
